meta.title: The Bus Station in the City

paragraphs: Grandma takes Lily and me on a trip to the city. We want to see the circus. First, we go to the bus station. It is a big building with a tall gray roof. Inside, there is a long hall. It is very loud. Many people walk and talk. The station is very busy. I hold the bags, and Lily holds Grandma's hand.

Next to the door, there is a ticket window. A woman gives tickets to people. Grandma buys three tickets. Above the window, there is a big board. It has numbers for the buses. Opposite the window, there are blue seats. We sit and wait there. Grandma has a cup of tea. Behind the seats, there is a small shop. It has water, fruit, and bread. "Can I have a banana?" asks Lily.

Outside, five buses wait at five bus stops. Our bus is at stop number three. The driver smiles and looks at our tickets. Lily sits near the window. On the wall, there is a big poster. It shows a clown with a red nose. "Is the circus near?" asks Lily. "Yes, it is near the station," says Grandma. I am very happy.
